title: Mani Singh Endures Dismemberment Joint by Joint

blocks.text: The execution continues exactly as Bhai Mani Singh had demanded: joint by joint rather than in a single crude stroke. After the first cuts at the fingers and wrists, the butchers move on to elbows and shoulders while he remains absorbed in prayer and refuses to let the sentence be softened.

The page dwells on the terrible precision of the punishment. Each limb is reduced piece by piece, yet Mani Singh keeps reciting Gurbani and accepts the ordeal as a conscious martyrdom rather than a defeat inflicted by the state.
Witnesses who had come merely to watch are shaken by what they see. The executioners grow afraid as the martyr’s steadiness turns the spectacle of violence into a public testimony of Sikh resolve.
